# Chumbley's Auto Detailing

> Mobile auto detailing in Gallatin and Hendersonville, TN. Hand wash, wax, full interior detail, headlight restoration. Owned and operated by Maddox Chumbley.

## Services

- Sidekick Detail Package — $109 — hand wash & dry, wheel & tire clean, windows inside & out, interior vacuum, tire shine
- The Patrol — $159/mo — bi-weekly maintenance plan, 2 visits per month, cancel anytime
- Hero Detail Package — $189 — hand wash, hand wax, full interior shampoo, leather conditioning, engine bay wipe
- Legend Detail Package — $449 — everything in Hero plus headlight restoration, engine bay deep clean, pet hair removal, odor neutralization
- Exterior Wash & Wax — hand wash, foam soak, hand-applied carnauba wax
- Full Interior Detail — vacuum, steam, shampoo, leather conditioning, deep crevice work
- Headlight Restoration — cloudy/yellow/hazy headlights restored to crystal-clear
- Mobile Auto Detailing — on-site at your home, office, or jobsite

## Service area

Gallatin, Hendersonville, Goodlettsville, Castalian Springs, Bethpage, Madison (Sumner + Davidson County, TN).

## Hours

Monday–Saturday, 8:00 AM – 7:00 PM. Closed Sundays.

## Why us

- Mobile — we come to you, no need to drop the car off
- Owner-operated by Maddox Chumbley personally — every detail he does
- 5-star Google reviews
- Transparent flat-rate pricing on every package
- Accepts cash, credit/debit, Venmo, Cash App
